BOARD OF ZONING APPEALS
Regular Meeting Minutes
January 14, 2025

CASE NO.: 01-25
Council District #5
BZA PETITIONER: John Smith
LOCATION: 1234 Woodward Ave
LEGAL DESCRIPTION OF PROPERTY: Lot 15, Block 3, Subdivision of Smith Farm
PROPOSAL: To erect a single-family dwelling on a lot that is 35 feet wide instead of the required 40 feet in an R1 zone.
ACTION OF THE BOARD: Motion to grant the variance
Affirmative: Jones, Williams, Brown
Negative: None
GRANTED as presented.

CASE NO.: 02-25
Council District #7
PETITIONER: Jane Doe Construction LLC
LOCATION: 5678 Michigan Ave
LEGAL DESCRIPTION OF PROPERTY: Lot 22, Block 1, ABC Subdivision
PROPOSAL: To use an existing building as a mixed-use development with ground floor retail and three residential units above in a B4 zone, where mixed-use is not permitted by right.
ACTION OF THE BOARD: Motion to deny the variance
Affirmative: Jones, Brown
Negative: Williams, Davis
DENIED as presented.

CASE NO.: 03-25
Council District #2
APPLICANT: Robert Johnson
LOCATION: 9101 Gratiot Ave
LEGAL DESCRIPTION OF PROPERTY: Lot 5, Riverside Plat
PROPOSAL: To construct an accessory dwelling unit in the rear yard of a single-family residence in an R2 zone.
ACTION OF THE BOARD: Motion to grant with conditions
Affirmative: Jones, Williams, Brown, Davis
Negative: None
GRANTED with conditions as noted.
